why: THE GUARD FAILING OPEN ON ITS OWN FLAG. Lines are split before lexing, so a backslash-newline left a dangling escape, shlex raised, and the whole command was reported unreadable — which main() treats as plumbing and ALLOWS. Bash joins the continuation and runs one hook-skipping commit. This is ordinary multi-line shell formatting, not an evasion, which makes it the one fail-open a drifting session reaches without trying.
